questions.prompt: Two forces of \(8\,\mathrm{N}\) right and \(3\,\mathrm{N}\) right act on one object. Find the net force.
questions.answer:
Both forces point right:
\[
\sum F=8+3=11\,\mathrm{N}
\]
The net force is \(11\,\mathrm{N}\) right.

questions.prompt: Write one newton in SI base units.
A box has forces \(15\,\mathrm{N}\) east and \(6\,\mathrm{N}\) west. Find the net horizontal force.
questions.answer:
Take east as positive:
\[
\sum F_x=15-6=9\,\mathrm{N}
\]
The net force is \(9\,\mathrm{N}\) east.

questions.prompt: A force of \(20\,\mathrm{N}\) acts at \(30^\circ\) above the horizontal. Find its horizontal and vertical components.
Two perpendicular forces act on a crate: \(12\,\mathrm{N}\) east and \(5\,\mathrm{N}\) north. Find the net force magnitude.
questions.answer:
\[
F_{\mathrm{net}}=\sqrt{12^2+5^2}=13\,\mathrm{N}
\]
The direction is
\[
\theta=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{12}\right)=22.6^\circ
\]
north of east.

questions.prompt: A \(4.0\,\mathrm{kg}\) object has a net force of \(10\,\mathrm{N}\) east. Find its acceleration.
A crate is pulled across a rough horizontal floor by a rope. List the external force types acting on the crate.
questions.answer: The crate has weight downward, a normal force upward, a rope pull along the rope, and friction opposite the sliding or impending sliding. Air resistance is usually ignored unless stated.

questions.prompt: A \(3.0\,\mathrm{kg}\) object has forces \(14\,\mathrm{N}\) right, \(5\,\mathrm{N}\) left, \(12\,\mathrm{N}\) up, and \(9\,\mathrm{N}\) down. Find the acceleration vector magnitude and direction.
questions.answer:
Net force components:
\[
\sum F_x=14-5=9\,\mathrm{N},
\qquad
\sum F_y=12-9=3\,\mathrm{N}
\]
For \(m=3.0\,\mathrm{kg}\):
\[
\vec a=\frac{\sum \vec F}{m}=3\hat\imath+1\hat\jmath\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}
\]
\[
|\vec a|=\sqrt{3^2+1^2}=3.16\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}
\]
\[
	heta=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)=18.4^\circ
\]
above +x (to the right).

questions.prompt: A \(5.0\,\mathrm{kg}\) crate is pulled by \(40\,\mathrm{N}\) at \(37^\circ\) above the horizontal on a rough floor with \(\mu_k=0.20\). Find the normal force, kinetic friction, and horizontal acceleration.
questions.answer:
Vertical equilibrium gives normal force:
\[
N+40\sin37^\circ-mg=0
\]
\[
N=5.0(9.8)-40\sin37^\circ=24.9\,\mathrm{N}
\]
Kinetic friction:
\[
f_k=\mu_k N=0.20(24.9)=4.98\,\mathrm{N}
\]
Horizontal dynamics:
\[
\sum F_x=40\cos37^\circ-f_k=31.9-5.0=26.9\,\mathrm{N}
\]
\[
a_x=\frac{26.9}{5.0}=5.38\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}
\]
rightward.

questions.prompt: A \(5.0\,\mathrm{kg}\) sensor must accelerate with \(\vec{a}=2\hat{\imath}-1\hat{\jmath}\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}\). Two known forces are \(\vec{F}_1=18\hat{\imath}+4\hat{\jmath}\,\mathrm{N}\) and \(\vec{F}_2=-6\hat{\imath}+10\hat{\jmath}\,\mathrm{N}\). A control thruster can only point at angle \(\phi\) measured from \(+\hat{\imath}\). Find required thruster magnitude and \(\phi\).
questions.answer:
Required net force:
\[
\sum\vec F=m\vec a=5.0(2\hat\imath-1\hat\jmath)=10\hat\imath-5\hat\jmath\,\mathrm N
\]
Known-force sum:
\[
\vec F_1+\vec F_2=(18-6)\hat\imath+(4+10)\hat\jmath=12\hat\imath+14\hat\jmath
\]
Thruster force:
\[
\vec F_T=(10\hat\imath-5\hat\jmath)-(12\hat\imath+14\hat\jmath)=-2\hat\imath-19\hat\jmath\,\mathrm N
\]
Magnitude:
\[
F_T=\sqrt{(-2)^2+(-19)^2}=19.1\,\mathrm N
\]
Direction from +x axis:
\[
\phi=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{-19}{-2}\right)
\]
Vector is in quadrant III, so
\[
\phi=264.0^\circ
\]
(equivalently \(96.0^\circ\) below +x).
